'''''Opuntia elata''''' is a species of cactus found in [[Bolivia]], [[Paraguay]], [[South Region, Brazil|southern Brazil]], northern [[Argentina]], and [[Uruguay]].<ref name="Tropicos 2019">{{cite web | title=Name - Opuntia elata Link & Otto ex Salm-Dyck | website=Tropicos | date=2019-08-04 | url=https://www.tropicos.org/Name/5106735 | access-date=2019-08-04}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Opuntia elata'' is a fast growing Opuntia with a tendency to branch out. It can reach up to 1-1.5 m in height and spread (occasionally 3 m). The joints may grow straight, white spines up to 3-4 cm long. 

The flower is orange to yellow in color, appearing around late spring up to summer. The fruit is club shaped and purple-red when ripe.<ref>N. L. Britton, J. N. Rose: ''"The Cactaceae. Descriptions and Illustrations of Plants of the Cactus Family."'' Vol I, The Carnegie Institution of Washington, Washington 1919</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
The plant can be found at [[Chuquisaca Department|Chuquisaca]], [[Cochabamba Department|Cochabamba]], [[Santa Cruz Department|Santa Cruz]], [[Tarija Department|Tarija]] of Bolivia. They can also be found growing at [[Cuba]].{{citation needed|date=April 2025}}
